steps.label: prep
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/work/cable_main" && cp "$AGENT_HOME/repo/packs/cable/"* . && rm -rf s && bash prep.sh && for f in $(seq 555 652); do rm -f r/$(printf 'f%04d.jpg' $f); done; ls r | wc -l

steps.label: render
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/work/cable_main" && for i in $(seq 1 10); do /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b cable.blend -P cable_render.py -- render 555 652 100 >> rfix.log 2>&1; n=$(ls r | wc -l); echo "pass $i frames $n"; [ $n -ge 1450 ] && break; sleep 5; done

steps.label: encode
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -framerate 25 -i "$AGENT_HOME/work/cable_main/r/f%04d.jpg" -i "$AGENT_HOME/work/cable_main/cable_mix.m4a" -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v libx264 -preset medium -crf 21 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a copy -shortest -movflags +faststart "$AGENT_HOME/work/cable_main/cable_1080b.mp4"
